answer: Copying the same citations across 257 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 257 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the nebula index resolves every citation against the walnut checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the cipher audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 3930 identities would post 2917 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
